description: Finds known words in source or the open comparison and returns handles for each match. Use kind to locate code syntax or Markdown structure.

case_sensitive.description: Text search only: match case exactly (default: no). Omit when kind is given; code names are exact, Markdown words ignore case.

document.description: The document value rapier.open returned. With a connected host it names the workspace and the connection is the authority; without one it is the workspace's whole authority, so keep it private.

kind.description: Code syntax or Markdown structure to match instead of text; fence matches a language, link a href, image an alt or label.

operation_id.description: Optional retry identity scoped to this principal, connection and document. An unchanged mutation replays its original result for 24 hours, even after later edits; its expired identity never executes again. A read replays while its receipt is retained; after 256 later reads it executes afresh. Reusing an identity with changed arguments refuses. Visual observations are fresh. Inspect before starting another operation. Calls without it never replay.

query.description: The text to find. Empty enumerates every comparison difference. With kind: a code name, or the element's words (a heading also by # to ######, a task by [ ] or [x]); empty lists every Markdown element of the kind.

scope.description: Search source even while a comparison is open, or search comparison differences. Defaults to the open comparison, otherwise source.

within.description: An outline ref to stay inside.
